title: Typeface for Brand and Creative Teams

BRAND & CREATIVE TEAMS

# AI creative powerhouse for brand-led teams

Unify brand management and creative workflows to generate on-brand visuals, maintain consistency, and scale production without compromising quality.

Use Cases

## Everything brand & creative teams need to scale impact

Arc Graph

## One source of truth for your entire brand identity

Brand assets live scattered across drives, docs, and creative tools. Keep every brand standard, asset, and guideline in one dynamic system with [Arc Graph](https://www.typeface.ai/product/brand-hub) — an intelligent system that ensures consistency and streamlines creative collaboration.

**Real-world impact**

A Fortune 500 CPG company scaled on-brand content creation 10x with Typeface, automating text and image evaluations against brand guidelines.

![Brand Hub Dept Page Brand and Creative](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/4PnPXcx39JKjrmUFMW81t3/29be2abfea345dd80ccee17396aec22b/Brand_Hub_Dept_Page_Brand_and_Creative.png)

CREATIVE CAMPAIGN SCALING

## One creative concept, infinite executions

Adapt your campaigns for every channel, audience, and market. Typeface generates infinite variations of your hero creative, adapting layouts, resizing formats, personalizing CTAs and localizing visuals while maintaining brand integrity at every step.

**Real-world impact**

A Fortune 500 grocery retailer generated 500+ unique assets with Typeface, customizing copy and visuals to shoppers’ dietary preferences, cutting production time by 55%.

![Creative Campaign and Scaling Dept Page Brand and Creative](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/4PnZgsayOEimZcbwjx4WH7/342a0a07774e87fa8d457e57ee66c7b0/Creative_Campaign_and_Scaling_Dept_Page_Brand_and_Creative.png)

ON-BRAND VISUALS

## Visual content made easy. No design bottlenecks.

[Image Agent](https://www.typeface.ai/product/image-agent) learns your visual language to create brand–aligned product shots, lifestyle photography and more. [Video Agent](https://www.typeface.ai/product/video-agent) generates channel-optimized video ads, social snippets, and sizzle reels, stitching narratives from existing assets.

![On brand visuals Dept Page Brand and Creative](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/6pSAFKwiHChpTZkXVsV7at/5d715d2ab0c0b747824a53d06d4ccb77/On_brand_visuals_Dept_Page_Brand_and_Creative.png)

CUSTOM AGENTS

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

* * *

Can Typeface work with our existing brand assets and guidelines?

Absolutely. Upload your brand book, logo files, color palettes, typography systems, image libraries, and tone of voice guidelines into the [Arc Graph](https://www.typeface.ai/product/brand-hub). Typeface learns from all of it and uses your assets as the foundation for everything it generates. Your brand system becomes the intelligence that guides all creative output.

* * *

Does Typeface integrate with our design tools and DAM?

Yes. Typeface connects directly to major design platforms like Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma, plus most DAM systems. Generated assets can flow directly into your existing creative workflows, maintaining proper metadata and version control.

* * *

What if we need custom illustrations or specific design styles?

The [Arc Graph](https://www.typeface.ai/product/brand-hub) can be trained on your custom illustration style, photography aesthetic, or unique design language. Upload examples of your visual style, and Typeface generates new assets that match.
